title: PodcastOne (Nasdaq: PODC) Launches Original Podcast It's Okay, We're All Gonna Die and Acquires Life Happens with Barb and Michelle Podcast
summary: YouTube and Social Following for Hosts Top Three Million Subscribers and Followers; PodcastOne Total Showcount 210 LOS ANGELES, May 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - PodcastOne (Nasdaq: PODC ), a leading publisher and podcast sales network, announced today the network launch of It's Okay, We're All Gonna Die with Nurse Julie podcast and the acquisition of Life Happens with Barb and Michelle podcast further strengthening its growing roster of top, cross genre podcast programming. “Mental health and wellness continues to be one of the most engaging podcast genres, and these two new additions to PodcastOne podcasts reflect our commitment to investing in premium and informative content that resonates with audiences,” said Kit Gray, President and Co-Founder of PodcastOne. It's Okay, We're All Gonna Die with Nurse Julie, Bad news: we’re all going to die. Good news: it might be the best motivation you’ll ever have.
